notice: Deterministic synthetic frames for client-side parser evaluation. No provider credentials or real user content.

splitCases: Split between CR/LF or newline delimiters so one frame arrives over multiple reads.
Split inside the JSON data line.
Split the multibyte UTF-8 encoding of the first Arabic character in the token across two byte chunks before TextDecoder decoding.
Join the token, citations, and done frames into one network chunk.
arbitraryNetworkChunkBoundaries.expected: Same decoded text, one citation, and one done event as success; never drop or duplicate a frame.

prematureEof.expected: Must not mark successful completion when the stream closes without done; stop loading and expose the documented incomplete-stream error.

httpFailures.expected: Expire session or request login; never remain loading.
Show a recoverable error; never treat a non-2xx response as an SSE success.
